⚠️ - THIS GAME IS NO LONGER IN ACTIVE DEVELOPEMENT! - ⚠️
Yes, GAK is not being worked on as of now. We're busy with other projects at the moment, however, GAK does have a full remaster in the works, so stay tuned for that! 👀

👑 Welcome to Grow A Kingdom 👑

🏰 Grow your tiny kingdom into a mighty empire
👷 Hire builders to expand your lands
⚔️ Hire knights to defend your kingdom
🕵️ Send assassins & thieves to raid others
🏞️ Watch villagers walk, work, and live in your world
🔥 Expand endlessly, no limits to your growth
